message: v1.8.30: Add BUiD university preset and fix Other university session/origin fallback
changelog: Postgraduate Studies Toggle (src/types.ts, src/core/universities.ts, src/core/studentProfile.ts, src/popup/index.html, mobile-web/companion/index.html, src/popup/universitySettings.ts, src/mobile/app/09-profile-semesters.js): Added a Postgraduate Studies switch under Settings > General > Your University (and Quick Tour onboarding) synced across extension, Companion PWA, and Cloudflare sync worker (studyLevel), automatically switching built-in and other university grading scales and minimum pass thresholds to postgraduate standards (e.g. BUiD M-Level 70%/60%/50% pass, UOS C+ 75% pass).
